blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Two high-profile fugitives—including the Davao region’s most wanted person and an alleged communist guerrilla medic—were arrested in separate manhunt operations across the Caraga region. The movements were done on Wednesday, Oct. 1, Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13) said Saturday. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, chief of PRO-13, said operatives tracked down a 41-year-old murder suspect, identified only by the alias “Jess,” in Barangay Bayugan 3, Rosario town, Agusan del Sur. Jess, a resident of Magdum, Tagum City in Davao del Norte, is listed as the No. 1 most wanted person in Region 11 (Davao Region). He […]...
